rows.meaning: Only strings that tokenize to exactly one token are kept, as ascending llama_token ids de-duplicated in a set, so send one-token strings and read preserved_tokens back to see what was kept.

no_rows.reason: the field_json handler evaluates data.at("echo").get<bool>() and discards the result, and generation_settings has no echo key, so echo:true is a 200 whose generation_settings equals the field-omitted call and echo:"yes" is a type_error 400, never a bounds 400

one-key values either 400 with a non-bounds message (bare string: cannot use at() with string; {"type": 1, "value": "Once"}: Grammar trigger word should be marked as preserved token) or come back unchanged (type 2 and type 3 objects), and the only transformed form, a word trigger rewritten to {"type": 0, "value": "Once", "token": 403}, needs preserved_tokens in the same request

live.message: Field 'grammar_triggers': Grammar trigger word should be marked as preserved token: Once

no_rows.reason: field_bool stores params.sampling.reasoning_control but server-task.cpp to_json never emits it, so reasoning_control:true is a 200 whose generation_settings has no reasoning_control key and equals the field-omitted call, and 1 or "true" is a type_error 400, not a bounds 400
